in_sanskrit.name: करुण्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the mother to all, the father to all, the sustainer of all life, and the knower of one's own self.

in_hindi.name: करुणा
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is compassionate, a giver of life, free, and self-realized.

in_tamil.name: கருண்யா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is full of compassion, love, motherly care, and self-sufficient.

in_telugu.name: కరుణ్య
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is compassionate, sustains life, pleasing, and self-sufficient.

in_marathi.name: Karunya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karunya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Karunya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘karuna’ which means compassion, mercy, and kindness. This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture to symbolize the qualities of warmth, tenderness, and understanding.
